title: Billing Q&A: Returned-Payment Fees Re-Collected by a Card Catch-Up Charge (Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, Storage Units)
content:
**Basis.** The card catch-up charge on a storage unit agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the returned-payment fee twice where two returned-payment fees are posted on the agreement after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date, once where one is posted, and nothing otherwise. Two or more such fees add it twice.

**Q. Which entries are counted?** Fee entries of type returned-payment fee on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger dated after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date. The period a fee was posted for does not matter; its entry date does.

**Q. What figure is added per fee?** The returned-payment fee of the agreement's unit class:

| Unit class | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $35.00 |

**Q. Handling date 10 August; returned-payment fees dated 12 July and 2 August on a Bluegate Climate Controlled unit (hypothetical).** Both fall after 10 July and up to 10 August: $30.00 twice, $60.00.

**Q. Same unit, fees dated 10 July and 2 August.** The 10 July fee is not after 10 July: one fee counted, $30.00.

**Q. No returned-payment fee in the window.** Nothing is added.
